note: Frozen once at the public-history cut. The S20-300 and S20-620 checkers bind a lane's `<key>_revision_<N>` PASS to the commit its note names (`on <40-hex>`) by reading that commit's copy of the contract and its Status-line revision. Commits named by review notes before the cut exist only in the archived history (evidence/history/pre-public-history.json), so their contract text cannot be read in the public repository. This record keeps the Status line of each contract at every archived commit a review note in those two machine-summary sections names, read from the archive with `git show <commit>:<path>`; `blob` is `git rev-parse <commit>:<path>`, so anyone holding the bundle can reproduce every entry. Commits in the public repository are still read live with git; an archived commit absent here, or a commit in neither the repository nor the ledger, fails closed.
